definition.message:
{{#is_alert}}
## What's happening?

The **{{feature.name}}** license on firewall **{{device_ip.name}}** has expired.
{{/is_alert}}

{{#is_recovery}}
## Recovered

The {{feature.name}} license on firewall {{device_ip.name}} is no longer expired.
{{/is_recovery}}

{{^is_recovery}}

---

## Impact

The matching security service, such as threat prevention or URL filtering, no longer receives updates.

---

## Why?

Possible causes:
* **The subscription reached its end date without being renewed.**
* **The license was renewed, but the firewall has not retrieved the new license key yet.**

---

## How to troubleshoot and resolve the issue?

1. Run `request license info` on the firewall to check the license status.
2. Renew the subscription, then retrieve the license keys from the license server (Device > Licenses).
3. If you don't plan to renew this license, exclude it by adding `!feature:{{feature.name}}` to the monitor query.

---

## Related links

* [Documentation](https://docs.datadoghq.com/integrations/pan_firewall/)
* [Metrics Explorer](/metric/explorer?exp_metric=pan_firewall.license.expired&exp_scope=device_ip:{{device_ip.name}},feature:{{feature.name}}&exp_agg=max&exp_type=line)
{{/is_recovery}}

description: Tracks whether any licensed feature on the firewall has expired. An expired subscription stops the matching security service, such as threat prevention or URL filtering, from receiving updates.
title: License has expired
